name: Hitozuma Chijoku Hyakkaten
source:
There are two stories. First is about an elevator woman assaulted in the process of changing clothes and then blackmailed. The second one is about Kauzya cheating his girlfriend with his cousin.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作包含两个故事。第一个故事讲述一名电梯服务员在换衣服时遭到侵犯，随后又被勒索。第二个故事则讲述和也背着女友与自己的表亲偷情。
